transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Before we finalize the broadcast plan for Saturday's festival charity gala, I want to make sure we go through the standard final sign-off procedure. That means I need a verbal check with engineering and clearance on the record. We need to confirm the applicable licensing terms and any production changes before I can approve the plan. Let's start there.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Morgan, during this morning's final radio-frequency scan, I found that the wireless podium microphone intermittently overlaps the venue's emergency-communications channel. The podium must use the tested wired microphone instead. I recorded the scan in the engineering worksheet, but it hasn't been circulated to the production team yet, so this is the first formal disclosure.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Morgan, on the clearance side, I need to put on record that I confirmed with Northstar Archives this afternoon regarding the gala's licensed archival clip. The terms are: it may be streamed live only to viewers in the United States, it may not remain available as a replay, and it requires the on-screen credit exactly as 'Courtesy of Northstar Archives.' I have the licensor's email in the clearance inbox, but I haven't yet copied it into the broadcast plan. Given Jules's note about the wired microphone, these are two production changes that need to be reflected before approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for putting these on the record. Let me summarize the two production changes before I make my approval decision. First, from engineering: Jules has disclosed that the wireless podium microphone intermittently overlaps the venue's emergency-communications channel, so the podium must use the tested wired microphone instead. Second, from clearance: Rina has disclosed that Northstar Archives confirmed the licensed archival clip may be streamed live only to viewers in the United States, may not remain available as a replay, and requires the on-screen credit 'Courtesy of Northstar Archives.' These two changes directly affect the draft distribution plan, which currently calls for worldwide streaming, a seven-day replay, and a wireless podium microphone. Before I settle the plan, I want to confirm: Jules, is the wired microphone already tested and ready at the podium? And Rina, are the clearance terms I just summarized complete and accurate as far as the record goes?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Yes, Morgan. The wired microphone is already tested and ready at the podium. I completed the radio-frequency scan this morning and confirmed the wired mic is clear of any interference issues. It's good to go for Saturday.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Yes, Morgan. The clearance terms you summarized are complete and accurate as far as the record goes. The Northstar Archives clip is restricted to live streaming within the United States only, no replay availability, and the on-screen credit must read exactly 'Courtesy of Northstar Archives.' I still need to copy the licensor's email into the broadcast plan document itself, but the terms on record here are the full and correct terms.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Copy the Northstar Archives licensor's email and clearance terms into the broadcast plan document before final distribution.
Ensure the engineering worksheet noting the wireless microphone overlap and wired microphone substitution is circulated to the production team.

Geo-restrict the live stream to United States viewers only; disable replay availability; use the tested wired microphone at the podium; display on-screen credit reading exactly 'Courtesy of Northstar Archives' during the archival clip.
